description: Synthetic Emberwick trips seeded into QuestDB, queried through the official Grafana QuestDB plugin.

panels.description: QuestDB SAMPLE BY 5m; direct time-series panel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pickup_datetime AS time,
  count() AS trips
FROM trips
WHERE $__timeFilter(pickup_datetime)
SAMPLE BY 5m

panels.title: # Trips Over Time (5m buckets)

panels.description: QuestDB SAMPLE BY using the official plugin interval macro.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pickup_datetime AS time,
  count() AS trips
FROM trips
WHERE $__timeFilter(pickup_datetime)
SAMPLE BY $__sampleByInterval

panels.title: # Trips Over Time ($__sampleByInterval)

panels.description: QuestDB SAMPLE BY 15m with multiple numeric value columns.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pickup_datetime AS time,
  avg(fare_amount) AS avg_fare,
  avg(tip_amount) AS avg_tip,
  avg(total_amount) AS avg_total
FROM trips
WHERE $__timeFilter(pickup_datetime)
SAMPLE BY 15m

panels.title: Fare Metrics (15m buckets)

panels.description: QuestDB SAMPLE BY 15m with cab_type as the series dimension.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pickup_datetime AS time,
  cab_type,
  count() AS trips
FROM trips
WHERE $__timeFilter(pickup_datetime)
SAMPLE BY 15m

panels.title: Trips by Cab Type (15m buckets)

panels.description: QuestDB grouped table query over the selected dashboard time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pickup_neighborhood_name AS neighborhood,
  count() AS trips,
  round(avg(trip_distance), 2) AS avg_distance_mi,
  round(avg(total_amount), 2) AS avg_total_usd
FROM trips
WHERE $__timeFilter(pickup_datetime)
GROUP BY pickup_neighborhood_name
ORDER BY trips DESC, neighborhood
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top Pickup Neighborhoods

panels.description: QuestDB conditional aggregate expressed without PostgreSQL FILTER syntax.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pickup_datetime AS time,
  100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN payment_type <> 'CSH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count() AS card_use_rate
FROM trips
WHERE $__timeFilter(pickup_datetime)
SAMPLE BY 5m

panels.title: % Trips Paid w/ Credit Card (5m buckets)

panels.description: Expected: DPC. QuestDB timestamp_floor plus GROUP BY keeps a stable epoch-grid bucket.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp_floor('5m', pickup_datetime) AS time,
  count() AS trips
FROM trips
WHERE $__timeFilter(pickup_datetime)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Timestamp Floor Buckets (DPC)

panels.description: Expected: DPC. SAMPLE BY with explicit NULL fill and a fixed interval.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pickup_datetime AS time,
  avg(total_amount) AS avg_total
FROM trips
WHERE $__timeFilter(pickup_datetime)
SAMPLE BY 10m FILL(NULL)

panels.title: Avg Total (SAMPLE BY 10m FILL NULL)

panels.description: Expected: DPC. SAMPLE BY with explicit bounds and NULL fill.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pickup_datetime AS time,
  count() AS trips
FROM trips
WHERE pickup_borough_name = 'Saltmarrow'
  AND $__timeFilter(pickup_datetime)
SAMPLE BY 5m FROM $__fromTime TO $__toTime FILL(NULL)

panels.title: Saltmarrow Trips (FROM/TO FILL NULL)

panels.description: Expected: OPC. PREV fill depends on rows before the requested extent.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pickup_datetime AS time,
  count() AS trips
FROM trips
WHERE pickup_borough_name = 'Saltmarrow'
  AND $__timeFilter(pickup_datetime)
SAMPLE BY 5m FILL(PREV)

panels.title: Saltmarrow Trips (FILL PREV)

panels.description: Expected: OPC. The window frame spans neighboring buckets and cannot be split safely.

targets.rawSql:
WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT
    pickup_datetime,
    count() AS trips
  FROM trips
  WHERE $__timeFilter(pickup_datetime)
  SAMPLE BY 5m
)
SELECT
  pickup_datetime AS time,
  avg(trips) OVER (
    ORDER BY pickup_datetime
    ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS trips_1h_avg
FROM buckets
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Trips, 1h Moving Average (window function)

panels.description: Expected: DPC. Re-samples the materialized view using QuestDB SAMPLE BY.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pickup_datetime AS time,
  cab_type,
  sum(trips) AS trips
FROM trips_15m
WHERE $__timeFilter(pickup_datetime)
SAMPLE BY 15m

panels.title: Trips by Cab Type (trips_15m SAMPLE BY 15m)

panels.description: Expected: OPC. Variable-length month buckets are object-cached.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pickup_datetime AS time,
  count() AS trips
FROM trips
WHERE $__timeFilter(pickup_datetime)
SAMPLE BY 1M

panels.title: Trips by Month (SAMPLE BY 1M)

panels.description: Expected: OPC. Raw QuestDB TICK idiom: pickup_datetime IN '$now-6h..$now'.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pickup_datetime AS time,
  count() AS trips
FROM trips
WHERE pickup_datetime IN '$now-6h..$now'
SAMPLE BY 15m

panels.title: Trips in the Last 6 Hours (TICK range)

panels.description: Expected: DPC. Uses QuestDB's native day-and-duration interval syntax.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pickup_datetime AS time,
  count() AS trips
FROM trips
WHERE pickup_datetime IN '$today;1d'
SAMPLE BY 1h

panels.title: Trips in the Selected Day (TICK interval)

panels.description: Expected: directive-controlled partial_end step alignment; the directive is kept in the SQL comment.

targets.rawSql:
/* trickster-step-align:partial_end */
SELECT
  pickup_datetime AS time,
  count() AS trips
FROM trips
WHERE $__timeFilter(pickup_datetime)
SAMPLE BY 5m
